overview: You read the Rose's bill, the first part of Hercules at two, and you did not go. Your own afternoon was in this yard.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the bill and did not cross.

parties.name: Philip Henslowe
parties.context: Not in the yard. The bill was his afternoon, and that was all.
